claim_searched: For positive integer {1,K} Gasoline inputs, position-first exact-LP iterative rounding has IR <= initial LP + K - 2 and exact original-index worst-case ratio 2 - 2/K.
conclusion: No verified earlier resolution found in the searches performed. Priority is not established.

sources.finding: Conjecture 3.1.1, printed page 21, concerns two-size iterative rounding. Proposition 3.1.4 concerns a different greedy algorithm.
Rajkovic (2022), Algorithm 3.4.1, describes sequential LP look-ahead. Its broader 1D conjecture is not settled by this two-size result.
Nikoleit et al. (2026), section 2.2.4, describes the unrestricted 1D guarantee as unknown. Its refutation concerns dimensions at least two.
The repository implements Gasoline iterative rounding using Gurobi. It does not supply a proof of the exact two-size claim in the inspected material.

limitations: Several exact queries produced irrelevant or no useful matches; these are weak negative evidence.
GitHub and X were queried through a public web index; this does not exhaust their content.
A previous VibeMathed snapshot contained 755 entries and no matching terms; the snapshot is not a live exhaustive publication registry.
AI-generated secondary summaries that misstate the 1D guarantee were excluded as evidence of a proof.
